titre: Devoir de contrôle n°3 - Anglais (2ème année secondaire)

exercices.enonce:
TEXT
Water is the source of all life on Earth, yet we often waste it without thinking. A person can live for weeks without food, but only a few days without water. Today, however, clean water is becoming rare in many countries. Millions of people, especially in poor regions, do not have access to safe drinking water. At the same time, in richer countries, huge amounts of water are wasted every day: taps are left running, pipes leak, and swimming pools are filled for pleasure. If we continue like this, future generations will face a terrible water crisis. Each of us can help by taking shorter showers, repairing leaks and never wasting this precious resource.

I. READING COMPREHENSION (8 marks)
1) Why is water described as "the source of all life"?   (2 marks)
2) What problem do millions of people in poor regions face?   (2 marks)
3) Give two examples of how water is wasted in richer countries.   (2 marks)
4) What will happen if we continue wasting water?   (2 marks)

II. LANGUAGE (6 marks)
1) Complete the first conditional: If we continue like this, future generations ______ (face) a water crisis.   (1,5 marks)
2) Put into the passive: "People waste huge amounts of water."   (1,5 marks)
3) Complete with "can": Each of us ______ help by saving water.   (1,5 marks)
4) Give the opposite of "rare" = ______.   (1,5 marks)

III. WRITING (6 marks)
"How can we save water?" Write a paragraph (about 8-10 lines) giving at least two solutions and explaining their importance. Use "should / can" and linkers.
